note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative. An exploded view of a route configured between abstract bodies: plates of the same size on one row (no rank, level or hierarchy), their neutral intake trays (the brief's 'filtros', never an admission filter), the numbered steps of the supplied sequence, the placeholder sheet and the supplied route state (● available / ◆ not checked — a pending state, dashed). Only the supplied relationships are drawn; a plain relation has no arrowhead and causal links appear only when supplied. No admissibility, time limit, leave, ground, outcome or jurisdiction is drawn. Brief fields: decisions, routes, outcomes, elements, relationships, focusElement, relationLabels and traversalOrder are editable (routeState chooses the state shown). OMITTED brief field: grounds — grounds of a challenge would add legal content the mechanism of a configured route does not need. The 'calendario' object of the brief is left out of the exploded view: no time element is supplied, and a calendar beside a route could be read as a time limit.
